options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: The IPsec authentication method this tunnel will use.

options.name: caref
options.description: The certificate authority to use when validating the peer certificate.

options.name: certref
options.description: The certificate which identifies this system. The certificate must have at least one non-wildcard SAN.

options.name: closeaction
options.description: The option used to control the behavior when the remote peer unexpectedly closes a child SA (P2)

options.name: descr
options.description: A description for this IPsec phase 1 entry.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables this IPsec phase 1 entry.

options.name: dpd_delay
options.description: The delay (in seconds) between sending peer acknowledgement messages.

options.name: dpd_maxfail
options.description: The number of consecutive failures allowed before disconnecting.

options.name: encryption
options.description: The encryption algorithms supported by this P1 encryption.

options.name: gw_duplicates
options.description: Enables or disables the allowance of multiple phase 1 configurations with the same remote gateway endpoint.

options.name: ikeport
options.description: The UDP port for IKE on the remote gateway. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: iketype
options.description: The IKE protocol version this phase 1 entry will use.

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface for the local endpoint of this phase 1 entry. This should be an interface that is reachable by the remote peer.

options.name: lifetime
options.description: The hard child SA lifetime (in seconds) after which the child SA will be expired.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mobike
options.description: Enables or disables the use of MOBIKE for this tunnel.

options.name: mode
options.description: The IKEv1 negotiation mode this phase 1 entry will use.

options.name: myid_data
options.description: The identifier value used by the local end of the tunnel. This must be a value that corresponds with the current `myid_type` value.

options.name: myid_type
options.description: The identifier type used by the local end of the tunnel.

options.name: nat_traversal
options.description: The option used to enable the use of NAT-T (i.e. the encapsulation of ESP in UDP packets) if needed, which can help with clients that are behind restrictive firewalls.

options.name: nattport
options.description: The UDP port for NAT-T on the remote gateway. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: peerid_data
options.description: The identifier value used by the remote end of the tunnel. This must be a value that corresponds with the current `peerid_type` value.

options.name: peerid_type
options.description: The identifier type used by the remote end of the tunnel.

options.name: pre_shared_key
options.description: The Pre-Shared Key (PSK) value. This key must match on both peers and should be long and random to protect the tunnel and its contents. A weak Pre-Shared Key can lead to a tunnel compromise.

options.name: prfselect_enable
options.description: Enables or disables manual Pseudo-Random Function (PRF) selection.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The IP version this phase 1 entry will use.

options.name: rand_time
options.description: A random value up to this amount will be subtracted from the `rekey_time` to avoid simultaneous renegotiation.

options.name: reauth_time
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) before an child SA is torn down and recreated from scratch, including authentication.

options.name: rekey_time
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) before an child SA establishes new keys.

options.name: remote_gateway
options.description: The IP address or hostname of the remote gateway.

options.name: splitconn
options.description: Enables or disables the use split connection entries with multiple phase 2 configurations. Required for remote endpoints that support only a single traffic selector per child SA.

options.name: startaction
options.description: The option used to force specific initiation/responder behavior for child SA (P2) entries.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
